description: Workflow automation platform for mid-market HR departments. $420K MRR, 200+ paying customers, 15% month-over-month growth. 42-person team with offices in Austin and Toronto. Series B closed at $18M. Expanding into payroll integration.

description: Meal prep subscription service for busy professionals using local restaurant partnerships. Operating in 3 US cities with $55K MRR. Mobile app with 4.2-star rating. Exploring ghost kitchen model for better unit economics.
